newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria merchandise trade deficit seen wider in 96.
newsitem.headline: Austria merchandise trade deficit seen wider in 96.

text.p: Austria's merchandise trade deficit widened to 93 billion schillings ($7.8 billion) last year from 88 billion in 1995, according to provisional figures released by the Chamber of Economy on Wednesday.
In a statement, the chamber said exports rose to 612 billion schillings from 580 billion while imports increased to 705 billion schillings from 668 billion.

The state statistical office will issue final figures, but its data are currently delayed by more than six months due to the rigours of European Union membership. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-254 ($ = 11.89 Austrian Schillings)
